title: APL Apparels workers protest three months of unpaid wages
reason: The action was directed at private factory management to pay arrears; no demand on Bangladesh’s government or its policy is reported.
notes: Workers did stage a public highway blockade, but the account describes the owner paying the wages and the workers leaving. Attendance is unknown; the exclusion is based on the target, not size.

title: Islamic Movement Bangladesh rally over Israeli actions and remarks in India
reason: The reported demands concerned foreign actions and speech in India; the article identifies no demand on Bangladesh’s government or its policy.
notes: Public demonstration outside Baitul Mukarram after Friday prayers. Attendance is unreported. Excluded by target, not by size. The report says police took three people for questioning; this is not evidence of protester violence or a Bangladesh-policy demand.
